chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad, from Muʿallā ibn Muḥammad, from Aḥmad ibn al-Naḍr, from Muḥammad ibn Marwān, raising it to them عليهم السلام.
Regarding the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
“And it is not for you to hurt the Messenger of Allah”
regarding ʿAlī عليه السلام and the Imams عليهم السلام, like those who hurt Mūsā عليه السلام, so Allah cleared him of what they said.

key_terms.رَسُولَ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.فَبَرَّأَهُ: so He declared him free and innocent

ai.seo_question: How is the verse about not hurting the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم understood in relation to ʿAlī عليه السلام and the Imams عليهم السلام?
ai.summary: This report presents the Qur'anic prohibition against hurting the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم as applying to the matter of ʿAlī عليه السلام and the Imams عليهم السلام. It draws a parallel with the people who harmed Mūsā عليه السلام, whom Allah vindicated from their accusations.
